Pistons 144Wizards 140Top game

Cade's career-high 52 wins it in double overtime

Final · 2OT · Thu, Nov 12 · Washington

Detroit beat Washington 144–140 in double overtime, a 4-point road win. The Pistons move to 8–3; the Wizards fall to 4–9.

1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Pistons led 33–32 after one quarter. At the half, the Pistons led 64–61.

Scroll to keep going
2 of 5 · The difference

Cade: 52 points, a career high

18 in the fourth, 12 in the two overtimes. 11 assists, no turnovers.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the two overtimes 23–19

Tied 121–121 after four quarters, the Pistons won the two overtimes 23–19 to win 144–140. Cunningham and Jenkins combined for 73 of the 144.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it on the break and at the line

Fast-break points 26–12; free throws made 33–26. Three Wizards scored 30 or more.

5 of 5 · Final, 2OT

Pistons 144, Wizards 140.

From the Wizards’ side: Forced overtime, then lost overtime 19–23.

What it meant: Pistons 8–3, 3rd in the East, 97% top-6 odds. Wizards 4–9, 12th in the East, 4%.

2 · The play of the game

The fadeaway.

Cade Cunningham's baseline fadeaway with 25.3 seconds left in the second overtime that put the Pistons up 142–138.
